local.title: My Movies
local.description:
Your collection comes from the CSV export of the My Movies app, completed by TMDB. After setup, import the export from the My Movies panel (Import button) or the integration options.

The TMDB key is required: get it for free on [themoviedb.org]({tmdb_url}). The OMDb key is optional: get it for free on [omdbapi.com]({omdb_url}).

data_description.tmdb_api_key: Required. Free TMDB key (v3): covers, French titles, box sets, genres, ratings and production countries.
data_description.omdb_api_key: Optional. Free OMDb key: a fallback with IMDb data (rating, genres, countries, running time, director) for titles TMDB leaves incomplete.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: My Movies no longer accepts the password for {username}. Enter the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the My Movies service.
error.tmdb_unreachable: Could not reach TMDB to check the key.
error.invalid_omdb_key: OMDb rejected this API key (or its daily limit is reached).
error.omdb_unreachable: Could not reach OMDb to check the key.

init.title: Collection export and covers
init.description:
Export your collection from the My Movies app (CSV) and import it here; re-import it after adding titles. Titles currently known: {count}.

⚠️ Removing the integration deletes the whole collection kept in Home Assistant (titles, viewings, chosen genres and covers).

The TMDB key is required: get it for free on [themoviedb.org]({tmdb_url}). The OMDb key is optional: get it for free on [omdbapi.com]({omdb_url}).

data_description.export_file: The CSV file exported by the My Movies app. Leave empty to keep the current one.
data_description.import_mode: Only used when a file is chosen.
data_description.tmdb_api_key: Required. Free TMDB key (v3): covers, French titles, box sets, genres, ratings and production countries.
data_description.omdb_api_key: Optional. Free OMDb key: a fallback with IMDb data (rating, genres, countries, running time, director) for titles TMDB leaves incomplete.

error.invalid_export: This file is not a My Movies collection export.
error.tmdb_unreachable: Could not reach TMDB to check the key.
error.invalid_omdb_key: OMDb rejected this API key (or its daily limit is reached).
error.omdb_unreachable: Could not reach OMDb to check the key.
